name: Portable Hero's/Warchief's Call Boards list the shared PvE daily (#9948)
contract: Items 1913515/1913516 (Hero's/Warchief's Portable Call Board) cast item spells 995213/995214, whose SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR effect summons gameobject 412000/412001. Both entries already spawn and open the Call Board's three categories (#4186/#7504/#9088/#9419), but neither had gameobject_queststarter/gameobject_questender rows, so every category stayed empty: HeroCallBoard.cpp's ShowCategory reads quests by the clicked gameobject's own entry, not the permanent boards it mirrors (402000 Hero's Call Board, 402001 Warchief's Command Board). Mirroring those rows onto 412000/412001 makes the PvE category list the shared daily 18017 Culling the Felpaw on both portable boards, the same quest the permanent boards offer.

steps.label: SETUP: no Hero's Call Board owned yet
SETUP: the Hero's Call Board spawns
the board answers with its three categories
the category replaces the options with Return
DISCRIMINATING: Culling the Felpaw is offered on the portable Hero's board
SETUP: no Warchief's Command Board owned yet
SETUP: the Warchief's Command Board spawns
the board answers with its three categories
the category replaces the options with Return
DISCRIMINATING: Culling the Felpaw is offered on the portable Warchief's board
